description: This file defines the custom exception class `GLClosureInvalidException` used in the accounting closure module of the Fineract project. It includes an internal enum `GlClosureInvalidReason` specifying reasons for invalid GL closures and constructs an exception instance with relevant error codes and messages.

classes.name: GLClosureInvalidException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating invalid states during GL closure operations, extending a platform-specific base exception.

classes.name: GlClosureInvalidReason
classes.description: Enum representing specific reasons why a GL closure might be considered invalid, providing methods for error message and code retrieval.

methods.name: GLClosureInvalidException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific reason and date, passing relevant data to the superclass.
